subject.title: fix(qa): keep tracked runtime harness gaps advisory

question: Should the release gate treat the established, explicitly tracked Codex-native harness skip as advisory when the paired OpenClaw cell passes?
rationale: This changes the meaning of a release-validation outcome from blocking to advisory for a documented fixture condition; the exception scope is release-policy intent rather than an automated cleanup decision.

options.title: Approve the narrow exception
options.body: Keep the exact diagnostic-only exemption and use the paired passing runtime as product-path evidence while retaining structural-drift reporting.

options.title: Keep every one-sided skip blocking
options.body: Require removal of the harness gap before release validation can pass, even when the peer runtime passes.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow exception
recommendation.body: Keep the exact diagnostic-only exemption and use the paired passing runtime as product-path evidence while retaining structural-drift reporting.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context shows this person authored and is assigned to the release-tooling repair.
